arguments.command:
# Filter production files only: exclude *.test.ts, *.spec.ts, fixtures/
for pkg in media project mcp; do
  echo "=== $pkg ==="
  rg -l -e "from\s+['\"]@piwin/contracts['\"]" "packages/$pkg/src" -g '*.ts' -g '!**/*.test.ts' -g '!**/*.spec.ts' -g '!**/fixtures/**' 2>/dev/null | sort
done
